summary: 14 m of kerb at a junction corner on a through road; no parking.
reasons: Junction corner, nowhere to pull clear

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 11-12 m from the kerb at 4, 8 and 14 m, with more within 25 m; the grass corner is overlooked by them.
drivers.access_and_room: The kerb runs into a side-street mouth; only 14 m long with a kerb ramp at the west end, so a van would sit in the junction.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a side street joining; moderate traffic and turning vehicles.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb in either image.

flags: Stretch is shorter than a van plus clearance and sits at a junction
sun_shade: Open to sun, little shade from the grass corner.
